metadata.description: Write The Fine Manual — documentation skills for agents landing in an unfamiliar codebase. Docs as the index to the code, never a rival source of truth.

plugins.name: wtfm
plugins.description: Write The Fine Manual. Lands in an undocumented codebase and produces chunked, indexed, citation-backed docs another agent can navigate — an index to the code rather than a second source of truth that drifts from it, plus the two things code cannot state: a domain glossary and numbered decision records. Also diagrams, human explainers, a drift check, and an AGENTS.md that makes future agents read the manual first and the code second. Self-driving: fans work out across subagents from a goal and a ledger, and resumes after a dead session.
